metadata.question: Was there more snow in the Sierra Nevada mountains on January 1, 2022, than on April 1 and May 4, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare snow cover in the Sierra Nevada mountains across three specific dates: January 1, 2022 vs April 1, 2022 vs May 4, 2022. For snow analysis, MODIS is a good choice because it provides daily snow cover data. I'll use the MODIS Terra Snow Cover Daily Global 500m product (MOD10A1) which has the 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' band that indicates snow coverage percentage (0-100). Strategy: 1. Define Sierra Nevada region using a polygon 2. Get MODIS snow cover images for the three specific dates 3. Extract snow cover statistics for each date 4. Compare January 1 snow cover to both April 1 and May 4 5. If Jan 1 snow > both Apr 1 AND May 4, answer A: Yes, else B: No 6. Handle cases of no data or insufficient pixels I need to be careful about: - Checking collection sizes for each date - Validating pixel counts after masking - Ensuring the comparison logic is correct (Jan 1 > both other dates) - Using appropriate scale for reduceRegion ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sierra Nevada region const sierraNevada = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-120.5, 38.0], [-119.0, 38.0], [-118.0, 37.0], [-119.5, 36.0], [-121.0, 36.5], [-121.0, 38.0] ]); // Define the three specific dates const dates = [ {name: 'Jan1', date: '2022-01-01'}, {name: 'Apr1', date: '2022-04-01'}, {name: 'May4', date: '2022-05-04'} ]; const results = {}; // Process each date for (const dateInfo of dates) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(sierraNevada) .filterDate(dateInfo.date, ee.Date(dateInfo.date).advance(1, 'day')); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${dateInfo.name} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log(`C1`); return; } // Get the first (only) image for that date const image = collection.first(); // Get snow cover band and mask non-snow values (values > 100 are clouds/water/no data) const snowCover = image.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover') .updateMask(image.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').lte(100)); // Count valid pixels const pixelCount = snowCover.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sierraNevada, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`${dateInfo.name} Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`C2`); return; } // Calculate mean snow cover percentage const meanSnow = snowCover.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sierraNevada, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo(); console.log(`${dateInfo.name} Mean Snow Cover: ${meanSnow ? meanSnow.toFixed(1) : 'null'}%`); results[dateInfo.name] = meanSnow; } // Validate results if (results.Jan1 === null || results.Apr1 === null || results.May4 === null) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if Jan 1 has more snow than both Apr 1 AND May 4 const janGreaterThanApr = results.Jan1 > results.Apr1; const janGreaterThanMay = results.Jan1 > results.May4; console.log(`Jan > Apr: ${janGreaterThanApr}, Jan > May: ${janGreaterThanMay}`); if (janGreaterThanApr && janGreaterThanMay) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
